newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - FEDERAL EXPRESS STARTED.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - FEDERAL EXPRESS STARTED.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said Wednesday it began coverage on shares of Federal Express Corp with a buy rating and a 12-month price target of $75 a share.
-- Analyst Julius Maldutis said in a research note his 1998 earnings estimate was $3.59 per share and his 1999 estimate was $4.20 a share.
-- Said believes company's continued emphasis on cost reduction and yield management improvements will result in consistent and sustainable earnings growth.

-- "With continued globalization of the world's economies, Federal Express is well-positioned for enhanced profitability by providing its customers a seamless connectivity into the global marketplace," Maldutis said.
